Tomatoes - Ravi Kumar.comment: Very fresh, tasted great and lasted a full week in the fridge.
Good quality, delivered on time. Slightly pricier than the market but worth it.

Potatoes - Green Farm.comment: Perfectly sized potatoes, no rotten pieces in the bag.
Good for daily cooking, will order again.

Apples - Nilgiri Orchards.comment: Crisp and sweet, kids loved them.
Best apples I've bought online so far.

Bananas - Theni Farms.comment: A couple were slightly overripe on arrival.

Oranges - Coimbatore Growers.comment: Juicy and tangy, exactly as described.
Fresh batch, packaging could be better.

Mangoes - Salem Farms.comment: Amazing aroma and sweetness, felt like farm-fresh mangoes.
Worth every rupee, ordering more next week.

Grapes - Dindigul Vineyards.comment: Seedless and sweet, kids finished the whole box in a day.
Fresh and firm, good value for the price.
